Replace.Text: 发现自然奇观后解锁。在地图上显示“地脉”资源。“地脉”能为所有特色区域带来大量相邻加成。“地脉”额外提供1[ICON_Production] 。“地脉”可被覆盖和移除。可在“地脉”上建造采石场和农田。

Unlocked by discovering a Natural Wonder. Reveals the Ley Line resource on the map. Ley Lines give a major adjacency bonus to all specialty districts."Ley Line" provides additional 1 [ICON_Food] , 1 [ICON_Faith] and 1 [ICON_Production] . The "Ley Line" can be covered and removed. Mines and Quarries can be built on the "Ley Line".
